meta_description: Listening test: look at the context of a PICO-8 game, listen to four songs and say how well each one fits it.
home_title: How well does the song fit the game? A PICO-8 listening test
home_hero_title: How well does the song fit the game?
home_hero_text: You will see the picture and a description of games made for PICO-8, an 8-bit fantasy console, and listen to four songs for each one. We want to know how well each song, to you, fits that game. The descriptions and the answer options are in Portuguese.
home_facts_headphones_detail: if you can, to hear better
home_about_text: This test is part of the final project of DCC831, Generative AI for Music, at the Computer Science Department of UFMG. The project studies the composition of soundtracks for PICO-8 games, and your listening is its most important measure.
home_privacy_text: Your e-mail only lets you pick up where you left off. It is not stored: the server keeps only a code derived from it, which cannot be turned back into the address. Answers are anonymous and used only for this research.

how_step_listen_title: Look at the context and listen to the four songs
how_step_listen_text: Each scenario shows the picture and a description of a game, with four players: A, B, C and D, 30 seconds each. Listen to each one carefully; you can replay and seek as often as you like.
how_step_answer_title: Say how well each song fits
how_step_answer_text: For each player, choose one of the five options, from "Não combina nada" (does not fit at all) to "Combina muito bem" (fits very well). There is no right answer you are supposed to know: your impression is what counts.
how_step_profile_title: Tell us a bit about yourself
how_step_profile_text: Before listening, six quick multiple-choice questions: age range, musical experience, gaming habits, familiarity with retro games, region and headphone use.
how_note_text: Use headphones if you can and listen to each song carefully before answering. There are two scenarios, and the answers of each one are sent when you move on.
